digest.component_or_area: ticket store backend / S3 remote integration
propositions: rebar must support an encrypted S3 bucket as ticket-store remote via git-remote-s3 helper, maintaining identical git/event format and auto-commit/auto-push flow with data residing only in the encrypted bucket

concurrent or legacy S3 pushes can create multiple <sha>.bundle files for one ref, causing git ls-remote to return the ref at two SHAs and hard-failing fresh clones; this state must be detected and auto-healed non-interactively by merging divergent heads while preserving all commits
when sync.remote is an s3:// URL and git-remote-s3 helper is absent or below version 0.3.2, store init and push must fail closed with an actionable error message naming the exact pip install command
the optional S3 backend must be declared as a pyproject.toml extra with version pinning, availability checked via a require_s3_helper() guard, and enforced at push and init gates
operator documentation must cover optional [s3] dependency installation, minimum helper version, SSE-KMS bucket and CMK/IAM setup, and sync.remote=s3://… configuration
